<b>Flea Brew</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. When used, it temporarily increases Hornet's movement speed and the speed and cooldown of her [[Needle]] attacks.

== Usefulness ==
When consumed, Flea Brew increases the speed of [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]]'s walking by 36%, sprinting by 34%, the speed of her [[Needle]] attack swings by 50%, and decreases the cooldown time between her attacks by 50% for 10 seconds. The exception is the [[Beast Crest]]'s Fury state, where cooldown time is only decreased by 40%. [[Crafting Kit]]s do not affect this Tool in any way. 

When it is refilled at a [[Bench (Silksong)|bench]] it draws from a reserve of 30 uses. The reserve can be refilled at the [[Flea Caravan]] at a cost of {{R|30}} (or for free during the [[Festival of the Flea]]), regardless of how much of the reserve has been used.

After using the last charge of Flea Brew, using the tool again causes Hornet to throw the empty bottle. This deals a small amount of damage and breaks the bottle, requiring Hornet to spend {{S|10}} to repair it at a bench, or nothing if the Flea Brew is refilled at the Flea Caravan.

* Flea Brew is mainly useful against bosses or large enemies, though it can also be used for the additional speed in exploration and delivering [[Courier's Rasher]].
* The increased attack speed allows for greater damage and [[Silk]] generation, and the movement speed helps with avoiding attacks and chasing down foes.
* It is especially useful in combination with [[Flintslate]], as you will be able to attack more while [[Flintslate]]'s damage multiplier is active.

== How to Acquire ==
After finding five [[Flea]]s and moving the [[Flea Caravan]] to [[Greymoor]], talking to [[Grishkin]] will reward Hornet with the Flea Brew. Hornet can refill her reserve of the brew at the caravan for {{r|30}}. After starting the <i>[[Ecstasy of the End]]</i> Wish, the reserve can be refilled for free.
